subject.title: Workboard: duplicate proof entries on completion; 'passed' is worker self-assessment, not verification

question: Should Workboard retain `passed` as an explicitly self-attested worker result, or introduce a distinct independently verified proof outcome and hook contract?
rationale: The requested independent-verification behavior changes what consumers may infer from persisted proof status and cannot be safely selected from the report alone.

options.title: Keep self-attestation explicit
options.body: Deduplicate completion writes and document that `passed` records the worker's claim rather than independent verification.

options.title: Add a verified outcome
options.body: Design an opt-in verifier interface with a distinct persisted status so existing self-attested proof records do not imply external validation.

recommendation.title: Keep self-attestation explicit
recommendation.body: Deduplicate completion writes and document that `passed` records the worker's claim rather than independent verification.

likelyOwner.reason: The report contains the only concrete production evidence available for clarifying the intended consumer-facing proof semantics.
